raw_data.title: CroCoDeEL: accurate control-free detection of cross-sample contamination in metagenomic data
raw_data.abstract: Metagenomic sequencing provides profound insights into microbial communities, but it is often compromised by technical biases, including cross-sample contamination. This phenomenon arises when microbial content is inadvertently exchanged among concurrently processed samples, distorting microbial profiles and compromising the reliability of metagenomic data and downstream analyses. Existing detection methods often rely on negative controls, which are inconvenient and do not detect contamination within real samples. Meanwhile, strain-level bioinformatics approaches fail to distinguish contamination from natural strain sharing and lack sensitivity. To fill this gap, we introduce CroCoDeEL, a decision-support tool for detecting and quantifying cross-sample contamination. Leveraging linear modeling and a pre-trained supervised model, CroCoDeEL identifies specific contamination patterns in species abundance profiles. It requires no negative controls or prior knowledge of sample processing positions, offering improved accuracy and versatility. Benchmarks across three public datasets demonstrate that CroCoDeEL accurately detects contaminated samples and identifies their contamination sources, even at low rates (<0.1%), provided sufficient sequencing depth. Notably, we discovered critical contamination cases in highly cited studies, calling some of their results into question. Our findings suggest that cross-sample contamination is a widespread yet underexplored issue in metagenomics and emphasize the necessity of systematically integrating contamination detection into sequencing quality control.

recommendation_text: 本文通过高分辨率冷冻电镜技术，阐明了微管聚合酶XMAP215与成核模板γ-TuRC协同驱动微管成核的分子机制，为神经科学中神经元极化和轴突导向的细胞骨架调控提供了关键的结构性见解。研究精确解析了XMAP215的阵列TOG结构域如何识别α/β-微管蛋白异源二聚体，并将其定向递送至γ-TuRC表面，从而显著增强微管成核效率。该发现不仅解答了长期存在的“微管蛋白浓度如何被局部放大以突破成核活化能垒”的问题，更对理解神经元中高度极化的微管网络组装、发育中轴突的快速延伸及生长锥内微管动态不稳定性具有深远意义。对于从事神经发育、轴突再生及微管蛋白病研究的读者而言，这项基于体外纯化系统的结构-功能研究，确立了微管组织中心在分子层面的通用架构，其提出的协同聚合模型可推广至体内神经元复杂的微管调控网络。
reasoning: 微管细胞骨架动力学是神经元形态发生、轴突运输和突触可塑性的核心基础，该研究直接揭示了微管成核的分子机制。
feature_angle: 首次以近原子分辨率揭示了XMAP215如何重塑γ-TuRC构象以激活微管成核，为有丝分裂调控提供全新结构框架。
key_strength: 运用冷冻电镜解析了apo和结合态γ-TuRC的多个高分辨率结构，结合体外重组实验，实现了从结构到功能的闭环验证，方法学极为严谨。
key_limitation: 研究完全基于体外纯化系统，缺乏细胞内的功能验证；作为细胞生物学而非直接神经科学论文，其对神经发育或神经退行性疾病的转化贡献较间接。
target_audience: 结构生物学家、细胞骨架研究者、细胞生物学家，以及关注微管动态调控的计算和系统生物学家。
editor_note: 该文虽然使用经典的非洲爪蟾体外模型，但揭示的γ-TuRC和XMAP215协作原理高度保守，是理解哺乳动物神经元轴突发生与导向的基石性分子机制。

raw_data.title: Citywide indoor air sampling mirrors wastewater and clinical case surveillance of respiratory viruses
raw_data.abstract:
ABSTRACT

Wastewater surveillance of respiratory pathogens can provide timely estimates of viral activity and disease trends in a population. Indoor air surveillance could be used similarly with some advantages but remains largely unvalidated at the community-scale. Here, an indoor air surveillance program was employed as part of public health environmental surveillance in Chicago, Illinois, USA. Ten air samplers were placed in healthcare and congregate living settings across the city. Weekly air samples were evaluated for influenza A, influenza B, respiratory syncytial virus, and SARS-CoV-2 over two respiratory virus seasons. Citywide, aggregated air sample positivity and viral load were closely correlated with local clinical case and wastewater surveillance data across all respiratory viruses. Virus trends in air data often preceded clinical and wastewater, although this varied across pathogens and respiratory virus seasons. Further, whole-genome sequencing of SARS-CoV-2 showed close correlation of variant proportions across all datasets. At the building-scale, air samples obtained from a single sampling device provided efficient respiratory virus surveillance, with well-correlated estimates of respiratory pathogens. These data demonstrate that air surveillance can provide accurate estimates of respiratory virus infections and variants at a building or community-scale, serving as an alternative or complementary tool for public health environmental surveillance.

raw_data.title: Multi-focal ultrasound neuromodulation to the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex disrupts behavioural and neural pain processing
raw_data.abstract: Transcranial ultrasound stimulation (TUS) is a promising non-invasive technique for modulating deep brain regions involved in pain. TUS applied to the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (dACC), a region implicated in chronic pain and established target for deep brain stimulation, has shown potential for reducing pain. This study aimed to investigate the neural mechanisms underlying TUS effects on pain in healthy participants using neuroimaging. Thirty-two participants underwent two double-blind, randomised TUS-fMRI sessions (active or sham). A tonic cold stimulus was applied during multifocal dACC-TUS and during fMRI and magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) blocks. While no significant main effect of TUS on pain intensity was observed, active TUS showed a significantly greater reduction in pain ratings between 28- and 55-minutes post-stimulation, suggesting a delayed analgesic effect. Active TUS also disrupted the typical relationship between stimulus temperature and reported pain intensity, indicating altered sensory encoding. There was increased functional connectivity between the dACC and the supplementary motor area, pre-motor cortex, mid-ACC and the supramarginal gyrus, along with decreased coupling with the periaqueductal grey (PAG), and altered salience network connectivity. Overall, these findings suggest TUS to the dACC has multidimensional effects across behavioural and neural aspects of pain processing, supporting its potential therapeutic value.

raw_data.title: Developmental origins of exceptional health and survival: a four-generation family cohort study
raw_data.abstract:
Descendants of longevity-enriched sibships demonstrate a broad health and survival advantage throughout the life course. However, little is known about manifestations during very early life. Here we show a pattern of lower risk of adverse early life outcomes in third-generation grandchildren (N = 5637) of Danish longevity-enriched sibships compared to the general population, including infant mortality (Hazard Ratio = 0.53, 95% CI [0.36, 0.77]) and a range of neonatal health indicators. These associations in fourth-generation great-grandchildren (N = 14,908) were strongly attenuated and less consistent (e.g., infant mortality, Hazard Ratio = 0.90, [0.70, 1.17]). These dilatory patterns across successive generations were independent of stable socioeconomic and behavioural advantages (e.g., parental education and maternal smoking), maternal and paternal lines of transmission, as well as secular trends in the background population. Our findings suggest that exceptional health and survival may have early life developmental components and implicate heritable genetic and or epigenetic factors in their transmission.

Background

Previous researched has demonstrated potent health and survival advantages across three-generations in longevity-enriched families. However, the survival advantage associated with familial longevity may manifest earlier in life than previously thought.

Methods

We conducted a matched cohort study comparing early health trajectories in third-generation grandchildren (n = 5,637) and fourth-generation great-grandchildren (n = 14,908) of longevity-enriched sibships to demographically matched births (n = 41,090) in Denmark between 1973 and 2018.

Results

Lower risk was observed across a range of adverse early life outcomes in the grandchildren, including infant mortality (Hazard Ratio (HR) = 0.53, 95% CI [0.36, 0.77]), preterm birth (Odds Ratio (OR) = 0.82, [0.72, 0.93]), small for gestational age (OR = 0.83, [0.76, 0.90]) and neonatal respiratory disorders (OR = 0.77, [0.67, 0.88]). Relative advantages in parental education and maternal smoking were observed in both generations to a similar degree. However, a much smaller reduction in infant mortality was observed in the great-grandchildren (HR = 0.90, [0.70, 1.17]) and benefits across other outcomes were also less consistent, despite persisting socioeconomic and behavioural advantages. Lastly, maternal, and paternal lines of transmission were equipotent in the transmission of infant survival advantages.

Conclusions

Descendants of longevity-enriched sibships exhibit a broad health advantage manifesting as early the perinatal period. However, this effect is strongly diluted over successive generations. Our findings suggest that exceptional health and survival may have early developmental components and implicate heritable genetic and or epigenetic factors in their specific transmission.

Key Messages

Previous researched has demonstrated potent health and survival advantages across three-generations in longevity-enriched families. However, the survival advantage associated with familial longevity may manifest earlier in life than previously thought. In our study of third and fourth-generation descendants of longevity-enriched sibships, we observed a broad infant health and survival advantage reflected by protection against a diverse range of adverse birth outcomes. These advantages were strongly attenuated between the third and fourth generations, independent of otherwise stable socioeconomic and behavioural parental advantages, as well as maternal and paternal lines of transmission. Our findings suggest that familial aggregation of exceptional health and survival may have early life developmental components and triangulate to implicate heritable genetic and or epigenetic factors in their transmission.

raw_data.title: A tissue-intrinsic mechanism sensitizes HIV-1 particles for TLR-triggered innate immune responses
raw_data.abstract: In vivo, HIV-1 replicates within tissue, but how three-dimensional (3D) tissue-like environments influence viral spread and pathogenesis remains largely unknown. We previously identified an Environmental Restriction to cell-free Virus Infectivity (ERVI), imposed by collagen-rich 3D extracellular matrix (ECM), which diminishes HIV-1 particle infectivity. Here we report that ERVI is broadly implemented by various adhesive ECM components assembled into tissue-like 3D scaffolds. This restriction rapidly reduces infectivity within minutes, is saturable, and affects diverse primary HIV-1 strains and virions with distinct viral glycoproteins by impairing their ability to fuse with target cells. Importantly, particles subjected to ERVI also trigger pronounced pro-inflammatory cytokine secretion by monocyte-derived macrophages. Mechanistic analyses reveal that transient contact with collagen fibers induces conformational changes in the viral envelope glycoprotein (Env) and enhance its recognition by toll-like receptor (TLR) 2. This recognition promotes routing of viral particles into TLR8-positive endosomes, amplifying innate immune sensing of viral RNA genomes. ERVI thus acts via a dual mechanism: directly limiting the fusogenicity of cell-free virions and sensitizing them for innate immune detection. These findings highlight the biophysical properties of the ECM as a previously unrecognized, tissue-intrinsic barrier that restricts HIV-1 spread and promotes local inflammation representing a novel, broadly acting arm of antiviral innate immunity.

raw_data.title: Pedal cadence differentially impacts cerebral blood flow but not a postexercise executive function benefit: Evidence from active and passive exercise.
raw_data.abstract: An exercise-induced increase in cerebral blood flow (CBF) serves as a candidate mechanism underlying a postexercise executive function (EF) benefit. Here, healthy young adults completed four 20-min interventions of active and passive (via mechanical flywheel) cycle ergometry at pedal cadences of 55 and 85 revolutions per minute (rpm). Active and passive exercise were used because each modality increases CBF - albeit via distinct mechanisms - and different pedal cadences were used because an increase in passive exercise cadence is thought to increase CBF. Hence, we sought to determine whether the magnitude of a passive exercise increase in CBF influences the magnitude of a postexercise EF benefit. Transcranial Doppler ultrasound measured middle cerebral artery velocity (MCAv) to estimate CBF and the antisaccade task completed at pre- and post-intervention was used to assess changes in EF. Results showed that active exercise produced a larger baseline to steady state increase in MCAv than passive exercise, and both modalities showed an increase in MCAv with increasing pedal cadence. Moreover, both modalities produced a post-intervention reduction in antisaccade reaction times (RTs); however, frequentist and Bayesian statistics indicated the RT benefit did not vary with exercise modality nor pedal cadence, and the RT reduction was not correlated with active or passive exercise-mediated changes in CBF changes. Accordingly, active and passive exercise provide a comparable immediate postexercise EF benefit, and an exercise-mediated change in CBF does not provide a unitary account for the benefit.

title_zh: 踏板节奏差异性影响脑血流但不影响运动后执行功能获益：来自主动与被动运动的证据
reasoning: 该研究直接探讨运动（主动与被动骑行）对脑血流和执行功能的影响，属于运动神经科学与脑血流的典型研究，高度相关于感觉与运动神经科学。
feature_angle: 通过巧妙对比主动与被动运动，系统解耦了脑血流变化与运动后执行功能提升的关联，为理解运动-认知关系提供了重要的阴性证据。
key_strength: 实验设计精巧，通过主动/被动运动和不同踏频的2x2折因设计，明确检验了CBF作为中介机制的特异性，并运用频率论与贝叶斯统计双重验证阴性结论。
key_limitation: 仅为单次急性运动干预的健康青年研究，结论局限于运动模式对比，未能揭示执行功能获益的真正机制，对系统/计算神经科学领域的理论贡献有限。
target_audience: 运动神经科学、脑血流生理学及运动认知心理学研究者，特别是关注急性运动与认知功能关联机制的学者。

recommendation_text: 这篇论文深入探讨了网格细胞空间表征的动态可塑性，对于理解认知地图的构建和维持机制具有重要价值。研究通过大规模旷场扩张实验，系统性地揭示了网格细胞模块在空间环境剧变后表征崩溃、分裂与重组的完整动力学过程。其核心发现——网格尺度随环境扩张而放大但最终回缩，以及模块间的动态解耦与重组——为吸引子网络模型的边界驱动可塑性提供了强有力的因果性证据。该工作将网格细胞的经典模型从静态的、固定的坐标系，推进到了一个高度动态、经验依赖且以自我为中心参照边界校准的框架，代表了领域内重要的概念性突破。对于从事空间导航、神经动力学以及环路可塑性研究的人员而言，这项结合了精巧行为范式与大规模单细胞分辨率记录的研究极具启发性。
reasoning: 该研究直接探讨空间导航的神经基础，聚焦于内嗅皮层网格细胞的功能表征，属于典型的系统与环路神经科学研究。
feature_angle: 首次揭示网格细胞空间表征在环境剧变后的动态重塑过程，证明了神经地图的可塑性而非固定编码。
key_strength: 纵向追踪同一神经元群体在大规模空间变动前后的活动，将实验控制与长期记录完美结合，证据链条完整。
key_limitation: 发现属于重要的机制性进展，但未上升到足以改写空间导航理论的颠覆性范式层面；作者团队h-index较低，临床转化路径不明确。
target_audience: 系统神经科学家、计算神经科学家、研究空间导航与记忆巩固机制的研究人员
editor_note: 论文得分7.45，属于系统神经科学领域的高质量实证研究。虽理论冲击力极强，但可能因技术门槛和分析复杂性而使其影响力略显局限，故推荐语中着重强调了其概念性突破和对广义认知科能映射的启示。

raw_data.title: Environment heterogeneity creates fast amplifiers of natural selection in graph-structured populations
raw_data.abstract: Complex spatial structure, with partially isolated subpopulations, and environment heterogeneity, such as gradients in nutrients, oxygen, and drugs, both shape the evolution of natural populations. We investigate the impact of environment heterogeneity on mutant fixation in spatially structured populations with demes on the nodes of a graph. When migrations between demes are frequent, we demonstrate that environment heterogeneity can amplify natural selection and simultaneously accelerate mutant fixation and extinction, thereby fostering the quick fixation of beneficial mutants. We evidence this effect in the star graph, more strongly in the line graph, and also in a more general class of graphs. We show that for amplification to occur, mutants must have a stronger fitness advantage in demes with stronger migration outflow. In circulation graphs, where migration inflow and outflow are equal in each deme, we find that environment heterogeneity has no impact in a first approximation, but increases the fixation probability of beneficial mutants to second order. When migrations between demes are rare, we show that environment heterogeneity can also foster amplification of selection, by allowing demes with sufficient mutant advantage to become refugia for mutants.

title_zh: 环境异质性在图结构种群中产生自然选择的快速放大器
recommendation_text: 该研究从理论上证明了环境异质性在图结构种群中可以产生“自然选择的快速放大器”，能同时加速有益突变的固定与有害突变的清除。这一发现对神经科学界极具启发性：大脑本质上是一个高度异质、模块化、且存在层级网络结构的系统，其发育、神经连接模式的形成、以及肿瘤（如胶质瘤）的演化均涉及突变体在空间受限环境中的选择与扩散。本文建立的数学框架为理解神经干细胞谱系分化、突触可塑性竞争、乃至耐药性肿瘤克隆的进化提供了可直接迁移的建模思路。强烈推荐给定量神经科学家和计算生物学家作为跨学科方法论的参考。
reasoning: 该论文研究的是图结构种群中的进化动力学，核心内容属于种群遗传学和理论生态学，虽不直接研究大脑或认知，但其图论模型、空间结构化种群中的扩散-固定动力学框架可启发并应用于神经科学中的连接组演化、神经群体编码和系统生物学中的网络鲁棒性研究，属于具有跨域推动潜力的高影响研究。
feature_angle: 揭示空间异质性如何加速图结构种群中的自然选择，为复杂环境中的进化动力学提供全新理论框架。
key_strength: 创新性地将环境异质性与图结构种群遗传学结合，发现其在星形、线形等图上能显著放大选择并加速固定，超越了经典等位流动假设。
key_limitation: 模型假设迁移频繁或稀有等理想化条件，缺乏对中等迁移速率及真实生物种群复杂动态的验证，且与神经科学的直接应用链路尚未打通。
target_audience: 进化生物学家、理论生态学家、种群遗传学家以及对空间结构进化感兴趣的计算神经科学家。
crossover_value: 脑连接组具备明确的图结构，且脑内微环境（如氧梯度、营养因子浓度、细胞外基质差异）存在显著的空间异质性。本文揭示的“异质性加速选择”机制可被直接类比于：1）发育中的神经前体细胞在脑区间的迁移与命运决定；2）突触连接在活动依赖可塑性中的竞争与强化；3）脑肿瘤内耐药克隆的局部涌现与全局扩散。该文的图论与随机过程方法为神经科学领域提供了一套严谨的理论工具，用以量化异质环境如何塑造网络结构上的演化轨迹，对理解大脑网络形成、退化及病理演化具有跨界借鉴意义。
editor_note: 该论文虽属种群遗传学与演化图论领域，但其核心数学结构与结论对计算神经科学和脑网络的演化建模具有高度可迁移性。建议在推荐时侧重强调其方法论（演化图论、随机出生-死亡过程）在神经科学场景的映射潜力，例如将其视为一种分析脑网络竞争性组织原则的框架。

raw_data.title: Endosome maturation is orchestrated by inside-out proton signaling through a Na+/H+exchanger and pH-dependent Rab GTPase cycling
raw_data.abstract: Endosome maturation requires lumen acidification. Is progressive lumen acidification sensed by cytosolic-side molecules driving maturation? We show here that proton efflux through the endosomal Na⁺/H⁺ Exchanger (NHE6) activates the late endosome master regulator Rab7. Importantly, NHE6 is mutated in the childhood neurologic disorder Christianson Syndrome. We demonstrate that NHE6 interacts with the Rab7 GTPase-activating protein (GAP) TBC1D5 in a complex with Rab7 on the late endosome. This interaction and proton efflux are both required for Rab7 activation. TBC1D5 is potently inactivated with decreasing pH. A conserved histidine in the TBC1D5 GAP domain mediates pH-dependence. Furthermore, we show that neurons from mice engineered with a selective defect in NHE6 proton efflux exhibit blocked endosome maturation and disrupted Rab7 GTP-GDP cycling. In addition, knock-down of TBC1D5, thereby reducing Rab7 GAP activity, in NHE6 mutant neurons rescues Rab7 GTP-GDP cycling and endosome maturation. Finally, we present a biophysical model of proton signaling through acidic pH microdomains within the NHE6-TBC1D5-Rab7 protein complex upon endosome acidification. In conclusion, our studies provide evidence supporting a mechanism involving “inside-out” proton signaling, whereby lumen acidification drives endosome maturation through pH-dependent Rab GTPase cycling. Failure in this mechanism may have broad impact in neurodegenerative disease.

title_zh: 内体成熟由内向外的质子信号通过Na⁺/H⁺交换体及pH依赖性Rab GTP酶循环协调
recommendation_text: 这项研究揭示了内体成熟过程中一个精巧的“由内向外”质子信号机制，通过内体膜上的Na⁺/H⁺交换体NHE6将腔内酸化信号传递至胞质侧，调控Rab7 GTPase的活化。这一发现颠覆了传统的由外向内调控模式，为理解内体-溶酶体系统如何在空间和时间上精确协调提供了新范式。尤其值得神经科学界关注的是，NHE6的突变直接导致Christianson综合征这一严重儿童神经系统疾病，该工作将分子层面的pH感应缺陷与Rab7功能异常联系起来，为神经发育障碍的病理机制提供了明确的分子靶点，对开发干预策略具有重要指导意义。
reasoning: 该研究揭示了内体pH调控Rab7激活的分子机制，并直接关联到儿童神经系统疾病Christianson综合征的致病基因NHE6，提供了神经元功能异常的模型。
feature_angle: 首次提出内吞体成熟的“由内向外”质子信号传导模型，将腔内酸化通过NHE6-TBC1D5-Rab7轴与胞质GTPase循环直接耦合。
key_strength: 多维度证据链（生化互作、pH依赖性GAP活性、神经元敲入模型、功能回补、生物物理模型）严密论证了从腔内侧pH感应到胞质侧Rab7活化的分子机制。
key_limitation: 缺乏高时空分辨率的活细胞或体内实时成像数据，直接展示NHE6-TBC1D5-Rab7复合物上pH微域的形成与Rab7活化的动态过程。
target_audience: 研究胞内运输、pH感应及Rab GTPase调控的细胞生物学家，以及关注Christianson综合征等神经发育/退行性疾病的转化神经科学家。
editor_note: 原评分7.5/10反映了其在分子机制层面的深度与神经疾病关联的明确性，但信号通路系统层面的定量分析尚有拓展空间。推荐给关注膜运输与神经发育交叉领域的研究者。

raw_data.title: Condensin and topoisomerases cooperate to relieve topological stress at stalled replication forks
raw_data.abstract:
SUMMARY

Resolving complex topological structures at replication forks is vital for successful DNA replication, but the mechanisms are little understood. Evidence from diverse eukaryotes suggests that condensin – which promotes chromosome condensation in M phase – might also act during S phase to facilitate relaxation of torsional stress by topoisomerases. Here, we show in yeast and human cells that condensin binds stressed replication forks, where it cooperates with topoisomerases I and II to promote resection of the nascent DNA and restart replication. Our findings suggest that condensin acts with topoisomerase I at reversed forks to convert positively supercoiled DNA into structures that are subsequently relaxed by topoisomerase 2, allowing the fork to resume replication. These findings uncover an important, evolutionarily conserved role for condensin in handling topological constraints at arrested forks that is reminiscent of its function in chromosome segregation and might prevent formation of toxic chromosome structures during fork arrest and reversal.

raw_data.title: Three parsimonious spatiotemporal patterns in cerebellum reveal individual traits in function and behavior
raw_data.abstract: The cerebellum plays a critical role in large-scale brain functional connectivity structure and synchronizing global waves propagation. Despite extensive studies on cortical spatiotemporal architecture, particularly in zero-lag and time-lag synchrony, leaving the parsimonious cerebellar representational structure largely overlooked. Using complex principal component analysis (CPCA) on resting-state fMRI data from the Human Connectome Project, we delineate three dominant low-dimensional spatiotemporal patterns within the cerebellum, manifesting as unimodal-to-transmodal progression, functional antagonism, and hemispheric asymmetry. These patterns correlate with various empirical functional connectivity topographies, including functional connectome network structure, quasiperiodic pattern, functional connectivity gradients and brain network dynamics hierarchy. Importantly, functional connectivity reconstructed from these patterns preserves the intrinsic structural modularity, proving the robustness of the sparse cerebellar dynamics. Moreover, personalized CPCA-derived features enable accurate sex classification and prediction of cognitive, emotional, alertness and personality traits. Our findings position the cerebellum as an active, trait-sensitive integrator of brain-wide spatiotemporal organization, suggesting propagation-based motifs constitute a foundational mode of individual brain intrinsic function.

recommendation_text: 这篇研究巧妙地填补了小脑功能架构研究中的一个关键空白。当皮层中零滞后与时间滞后的同步化模式已被广泛描绘时，小脑的低维时空组织却很大程度上被忽视。作者利用复主成分分析(CPCA)在HCP大数据集上，清晰揭示出小脑内三种主导且简约的时空模式，展现了从单模态到跨模态的层级化梯度。这一发现不仅在计算上将复杂波动提炼为可解释的时空特征，更将其与个体化的行为与认知功能联系起来，为理解小脑如何在全脑同步中扮演协调角色提供了新颖的系统层面框架。对于研究大规模脑网络、层级加工和脑-行为关联的计算与系统神经科学家而言，此文提供了一个将时空动力学与个体差异精准链接的分析典范。
reasoning: 该研究通过分析静息态fMRI数据揭示小脑的时空表征结构，直接属于脑功能网络与系统神经科学范畴。
feature_angle: 揭示小脑三个简约时空模式作为个体功能与行为特征的可解码神经表征
key_strength: 创新性地将复PCA应用于小脑静息态fMRI，提炼出简约且可解释的时空动态，并验证其对个体化表型的预测力
key_limitation: 依赖HCP年轻健康成人数据集，缺乏跨数据集、跨年龄段及临床队列的独立外部验证，CPCA特征的可解释性和生物学意义可进一步深化
target_audience: 系统与计算神经科学家、个体差异神经影像研究者、小脑功能研究者
editor_note: 虽然摘要被截断，但其揭示的‘单模态到跨模态梯度’与当前皮层层级理论一致，表明该工作在系统神经科学中具有较高的理论整合潜力。

title_zh: 仿生纳米囊泡通过阻断交感神经-肿瘤交互作用增强慢性压力下的化疗效果
recommendation_text: 这篇论文精准地揭示了慢性应激下交感神经与肿瘤之间“神经-肿瘤串扰”的分子细胞机制，为理解神经系统如何系统性调控肿瘤微环境提供了关键证据。研究巧妙地利用生物仿生纳米囊泡作为靶向工具，特异性干扰去甲肾上腺素介导的信号通路，从而显著增强化疗效果。在概念上，它将肿瘤神经科学（Cancer Neuroscience）前沿与纳米医学工程相融合，不仅验证了心理应激通过特定神经递质影响癌症进展的假说，更提供了一种有望临床转化的精准干预策略。对于神经科学读者而言，这项工作的价值在于展示了从系统水平的应激反应到分子水平的囊泡递送，如何通过精确操纵神经-免疫-肿瘤界面来实现治疗获益，是“神经-躯体互作”领域一个方法学扎实、转化前景突出的范例。
reasoning: 该研究直接聚焦交感神经系统与肿瘤的微环境交互作用，涉及神经-肿瘤信号通路、神经递质调控及神经束追踪，属于典型的分子与细胞神经科学范畴。
feature_angle: 首次通过仿生纳米囊泡精准阻断慢性应激下的交感神经-肿瘤通讯，为心身肿瘤学提供了纳米级干预工具。
key_strength: 利用仿生纳米囊泡进行交感神经-肿瘤串扰的精准靶向阻断，方法学具有高度创新性和临床转化潜力。
key_limitation: 神经科学机制验证深度有限，未能阐明阻断交感信号后肿瘤微环境内神经免疫重编程的完整回路。
target_audience: 肿瘤神经科学、纳米医学及应激生物学研究者。
editor_note: 该研究作为肿瘤神经科学（Cancer Neuroscience）的代表性工作，符合《自然》或《科学》子刊对机制深度与转化潜力的双重要求。建议读者关注其化学遗传学与仿生纳米技术联用的实验范式，这是精确解析神经-肿瘤交互作用因果关系的优秀设计。

title_zh: 生化和脑异质性表征精神与非精神疾病
recommendation_text: 这篇研究以严密的计算框架挑战了精神疾病神经影像学中‘病例-对照’二分法的固有局限。通过对多中心大样本结构MRI数据的系统分析，论文揭示了脑结构异质性并非精神疾病所独有，而是同样广泛存在于类风湿关节炎等非精神疾病中，颠覆了将其作为精神病理学核心生物标志物的传统认知。其核心价值在于提出了一种量化个体偏离规范模型程度的新方法，将研究焦点从寻找群体平均差异推向刻画个体水平的跨诊断生物异质性。对于寻求精神疾病精准诊疗的计算神经科学家和临床转化研究者而言，这项工作提供了一个可跨病种、跨模态推广的分析范式，并为理解脑-体共病的复杂机制开辟了新的量化途径。
reasoning: 该研究直接探讨精神疾病和非精神疾病中的脑部异质性及生化特征，属于典型的临床与转化神经科学研究。
feature_angle: 通过整合多模态脑影像与血液生化数据，系统揭示精神疾病与非精神疾病共享及特异的生物学异质性，为跨诊断精准医学提供新框架。
key_strength: 大规模、跨诊断的多模态实证设计，将血液生化与脑结构异质性直接关联，分析严谨且结果具有理论深度。
key_limitation: 主要基于横断面关联，因果推断能力有限；发现的异质性模式对临床个体化决策的即时转化路径尚不清晰。
target_audience: 生物精神病学研究者、计算神经科学家、以及从事跨诊断精准医学与生物标志物开发的学者。

raw_data.title: Astroglial disinhibition of cortical circuits disrupts cognition via kynurenic acid in mice
raw_data.abstract: Astrocytes play critical roles in neural circuit function, but how they contribute to cognitive impairment remains poorly understood. Here, we identify astrocyte-derived kynurenic acid (KYNA), a neuroactive metabolite acting as endogenous N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDA) receptor antagonist, as a key mediator of cognitive dysfunction in the context of aberrant astrocyte activity. Using chemogenetic stimulation, pharmacological rescue, and astrocyte-specific knockdown of kynurenine aminotransferase II (KAT II), we show that elevated KYNA suppresses parvalbumin-positive interneuron activity in the prefrontal cortex, leading to disinhibition of pyramidal neurons and impairments in cognitive functions linked to cortical activity, including episodic-like and working memory as well as sensorimotor gating. These findings define an astrocyte-KYNA-interneuron axis that controls cortical excitability and cognition, linking glial metabolism to circuit imbalance and cognitive dysfunction with broad relevance to psychiatric and neurological disorders.

recommendation_text: 这篇论文揭示了星形胶质细胞通过犬尿喹啉酸（KYNA）调控皮层环路和认知功能的全新机制，对理解认知障碍的细胞非自主性起源具有重要价值。研究将星形胶质细胞异常活动、代谢产物KYNA积累与NMDA受体介导的PV+中间神经元去抑制效应联系起来，形成了一个从分子到环路再到行为的完整因果链。方法上，化学遗传学操控、星形细胞特异性KAT II敲低、药理学回补实验以及电生理记录的结合令人信服。该工作不仅为经典的犬尿氨酸通路赋予了新的细胞来源和功能意义，也为精神分裂症等认知障碍疾病提供了星形胶质细胞-神经元代谢偶联这一潜在干预靶点，对胶质生物学和突触生理学领域的研究者都有很高的启发价值。

feature_angle: 揭示了一条从星形胶质细胞代谢到皮层微环路去抑制，进而损害认知的完整因果链（KYNA-KAT II-PV神经元轴）。
key_strength: 多维度因果验证严谨：从化学遗传学操控到细胞特异性基因敲降，结合药理学挽救和跨多个认知范式，证据链完整。
key_limitation: 机制上未阐明星形胶质细胞活动异常的上游信号，且KYNA的细胞来源特异性证据高度依赖于单一酶（KAT II）敲降策略。
target_audience: 计算与系统神经科学家，以及研究胶质细胞、代谢和认知功能的神经生物学家。
editor_note: 摘要虽被截断，但核心发现（KYNA通过抑制PV+中间神经元去抑制锥体细胞，破坏皮层环路和认知）已清晰呈现。

raw_data.title: CLASHub is an integrated database and analytical platform for microRNA-target interactions
raw_data.abstract:
MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are ∼22-nucleotide RNAs that regulate gene expression, critical for development and disease. Residing in Argonaute (AGO) proteins, miRNAs target messenger RNAs via complementary base-pairing. Current miRNA-target databases rely on indirect data from AGO crosslinking immunoprecipitation (AGO-CLIP). In contrast, CLASH (Crosslinking, Ligation, and Sequencing of Hybrids) employs proximity ligation within AGO complexes, providing direct miRNA-target interaction evidence. Existing CLASH datasets remain limited to few human and mouse samples. CLASHub integrates CLASH-defined interactions with gene and miRNA expression data from human, mouse, Drosophila , and C. elegans , covering over 20 cell types and tissues. The datasets also include samples with ZSWIM8-knockout, an essential component in target RNA-directed miRNA degradation (TDMD)—a specialized mechanism for miRNA turnover triggered by basepairing with specific target RNA—thereby providing unique insights into miRNA turnover mechanisms. CLASHub also features a user-friendly Analyzer interface for CLASH, RNA-seq, miRNA-seq, and cumulative fraction curve analysis. Leveraging these tools, we uncovered a novel TDMD “trigger” for miR-335-3p degradation in ATP6V1G1 ’s 3ʹ UTR. Thus, CLASHub offers an online platform for miRNA research, enabling discovery of novel miRNA targets and triggers across diverse contexts.

raw_data.title: Quantification of disease-associated RNA tandem repeats by nanopore sensing
raw_data.abstract:
Summary

Short tandem repeat expansions underlie a class of neurological and neuromuscular diseases known as repeat expansion disorders (REDs), yet the precise characterization of these repeats remains technically challenging. Conventional amplification-based methods fail to resolve repeat length accurately due to amplification bias and sequence homogeneity. Here, we present a single-molecule nanopore-based strategy that enables direct quantification of tandem repeats in native RNA. By assembling RNA nanostructures that encode specific repeat number, we achieve repeat size discrimination with a resolution of 18 nucleotides. Using tandem repeat-containing RNA, we successfully detect and discriminate disease-relevant repeat lengths associated with myotonic dystrophy types 1 (DM1) and 2 (DM2), and congenital central hypoventilation syndrome-1 (CCHS1). Finally, we apply our method to total RNA extracted from a DM1 human cell line model, demonstrating its compatibility with complex biological samples. Our approach offers a platform for studying repeat expansion biology at the single-molecule level, with broad implications for diagnostics, clinical research and multiplexed repeat profiling.

title_zh: 基于纳米孔传感的疾病相关RNA串联重复序列定量分析
recommendation_text: 这篇文章提出了一种优雅的单分子纳米孔方法，直接对疾病相关RNA串联重复的长度和序列进行定量，这在技术上是对传统PCR和短读长测序的重大突破。研究者巧妙设计了RNA纳米结构，将特定重复数编码为可区分的电流信号特征，从而绕过了扩增偏差和均聚物分辨难题。该方法在神经退行性和神经肌肉疾病的重复扩增障碍（如C9orf72-ALS/FTD、亨廷顿病、脆性X综合征等）中具有广泛的应用前景，不仅可实现等位基因级别的重复长度精确测定，还为研究重复序列的转录后修饰、RNA foci的形成机制提供了新的单分子分析工具。对计算和系统生物学家而言，该平台输出的结构化电流时序数据也为开发新的信号解码算法和重复序列动力学模型提供了丰富的训练素材。本文虽侧重于方法创新，但其生物学问题的指向明确，值得神经科学社区的高度关注。
reasoning: 该研究直接开发了针对RNA重复序列的定量方法，并应用于肌强直性营养不良等神经系统疾病的重复扩增检测，属于分子水平上解析神经疾病机制。
feature_angle: 首次实现纳米孔对天然RNA中疾病相关串联重复序列的单分子直接定量，精度达18个核苷酸。
key_strength: 巧妙利用RNA纳米结构编码重复数作为内标，在复杂生物样本中实现了无需扩增的重复序列长度精准分辨。
key_limitation: 18核苷酸的分辨率尚不足以区分某些微小但具临床意义的重复长度差异，且目前仅验证了三种特定疾病模型。
target_audience: 神经遗传病研究者、RNA生物学家及单分子诊断技术开发者
editor_note: 该方法解决了困扰该领域多年的技术瓶颈，虽发表于方法学领域，但其在C9orf72等主流神经退行性疾病模型上的成功验证，使其对分子与细胞神经科学社区具有直接的变革潜力。

raw_data.title: The act of detecting a stimulus contaminates measures of conscious experience with decision biases
raw_data.abstract: A central challenge in consciousness research is determining whether observers have a conscious experience of a stimulus. However, present/absent detection judgments are often biased by contextual factors, making it difficult to isolate conscious perception from non-perceptual influences. Traditional psychophysical methods struggle to disentangle these components. To address this, we conducted in-person experiments (N=505) in which participants detected and reproduced dim and absent contrast defined Gabor stimuli under three contextual manipulations: attentional cues, asymmetrical base rates, and payoff schemes. Using a reproduction task together with a Hurdle-Gaussian model, we quantitively decomposed reproduction responses into a perceptual continuous contrast component and a non-perceptual “hurdle” component. paper.title: The act of detecting a stimulus contaminates measures of conscious experience with decision biases
paper.abstract: A central challenge in consciousness research is determining whether observers have a conscious experience of a stimulus. However, present/absent detection judgments are often biased by contextual factors, making it difficult to isolate conscious perception from non-perceptual influences. Traditional psychophysical methods struggle to disentangle these components. To address this, we conducted in-person experiments (N=505) in which participants detected and reproduced dim and absent contrast defined Gabor stimuli under three contextual manipulations: attentional cues, asymmetrical base rates, and payoff schemes. Using a reproduction task together with a Hurdle-Gaussian model, we quantitively decomposed reproduction responses into a perceptual continuous contrast component and a non-perceptual “hurdle” component. We found that statistical priors (base rate) and reward structures (payoff) induced non-perceptual shifts in the reproduction hurdle, whereas attentional cues selectively shifted the continuous contrast component, consistent with changes in conscious experience. Critically, comparing conditions with and without intermixed detection trials revealed that the presence of a detection task contaminates reproduction reports with non-perceptual criterion effects. This highlights the need for caution in using and interpreting results that rely on detection judgements, even when combined with subjective measures like reproduction, especially given the central role that detection tasks play in consciousness research.

title_zh: 超越人工启动筛查：完全自主脑健康监测的必然性
recommendation_text: 这篇观点文章深刻而及时地论证了神经科学和医疗保健范式转变的必要性：从依赖人为启动的筛查转向全自主的脑健康持续监控。作者巧妙地运用了当前技术在自动驾驶和可穿戴设备中的成功案例作为类比，勾勒出了一个“神经环路等级自主性”框架，为理解并逐步实现无感、连续的脑健康评估提供了清晰的路线图。对于神经科学家和计算生物学家而言，其核心价值在于挑战了我们对生物信号采样方式的根本假设——间歇性、低维度的测量方式天生无法捕捉大脑动态系统的真实状态或进行有效的超早期风险分层。文章不仅凝练地总结了当前的技术瓶颈，更重要的是提出了一种以个体化动态基线为核心的、结合多元生理信号与环境传感器融合的全新研究策略，这可能是开发下一代神经疾病早期检测系统的关键突破点。本文对于正在探索大规模脑数据应用和个性化神经医学的研究者具有极强的启发性。
reasoning: 论文直接探讨基于神经影像等技术的脑部疾病自主监测方法，属于脑科学临床应用与转化研究。
feature_angle: 本文提出从人类主导筛查向全自主脑健康监测范式转换的迫切性和概念框架，为神经退行性疾病的早筛研究指引新方向。
key_strength: 敏锐地捕捉到现有筛查范式的局限性，并系统性地论证了基于被动数据流、AI驱动的全自主监测系统作为下一代解决方案的必然性，具有前瞻性的领域整合与批判。
key_limitation: 作为综述/观点文章，缺乏实证数据验证所提出框架的可行性与临床效能，对潜在的技术瓶颈（如隐私、误报）和落地路径的讨论深度不足。
target_audience: 从事神经退行性疾病、数字健康与临床人工智能研究的计算神经科学家、系统生物学家和临床研究者。
editor_note: 该论文更像是一篇有前瞻性的观点/综述，而非传统的研究论文，因此在严格实证研究的评分标准下得分为7.05，但作为方向性指引文章价值极高。

raw_data.title: Spatial reorganization of object representations in high-level visual cortex distinguishes working memory from perception
raw_data.abstract: The human visual system balances veridical object visual perception with flexible object visual working memory (VWM), both relying on high-level visual regions. However, how these competing demands shape spatial representations remains unclear. Here, we ask whether VWM inherits the spatial constraints observed in the lateral occipital complex (LOC) during perception, or instead reorganizes these representations to meet mnemonic demands. Using matched bilateral presentation paradigms and fMRI-based decoding, we systematically compared spatial representations during perception and VWM. This approach revealed a striking dissociation: during perception, object information is largely confined to the contralateral LOC, whereas during VWM, robust ipsilateral representations emerge—even when both hemifields must be remembered. Vertex-ablation analyses revealed that VWM engages 70–90% of ipsilateral LOC territories, far exceeding those recruited during unilateral perception. Neither increased attentional span nor top-down feedback from association areas fully explained this expansion; rather, ipsilateral LOC patterns closely mirrored contralateral sensory representations, implicating interhemispheric coordination in VWM. Together, these findings demonstrate that object VWM flexibly recruits distributed high-level visual cortex, with spatial reorganization distinguishing mnemonic flexibility from perceptual fidelity.

title_zh: 高级视觉皮层中物体表征的空间重组区分工作记忆与知觉
recommendation_text: 这篇论文针对视觉系统中的一个核心理论难题——感知的精确性如何与记忆的灵活性在高阶视觉皮层中共存——提供了优雅的机制性答案。通过设计精巧的匹配式双侧呈现范式并结合fMRI解码，作者有力地证明了视觉工作记忆并非被动地继承早期视觉皮层的空间组织约束（如对侧偏好），而是在LOC等区域进行了主动的“空间重组”（Spatial Reorganization），以脱离物理现实、服务于更抽象的认知表征。这一发现具有很高的理论价值，它不仅深化了我们对工作记忆神经基础的理解，将研究焦点从感觉皮层扩展到高阶区域，还为感知-记忆分离提供了清晰的皮层组织原则。对于致力于理解大脑如何动态重构信息以满足不同行为需求的系统和计算神经科学家而言，该方法论和分析逻辑同样具有启发性。
reasoning: 该研究直接对比视觉知觉与工作记忆在高级视觉皮层（LOC）的空间表征，揭示了从对侧到双侧表征的认知加工差异，属于典型认知神经科学议题。
feature_angle: 揭示视觉工作记忆通过半球间重组对侧感觉表征，打破感知的单侧束缚，为记忆的分布式表征提供了因果证据。
key_strength: 通过精心设计的双侧呈现范式与顶点消融分析，对工作记忆中同侧LOC区域的因果贡献进行了精准量化，实验逻辑严密。

title_zh: 天然非编码pumilio变异重调价值编码中间神经元以偏置果蝇产卵决策
recommendation_text: 这篇论文在系统与环路水平上，将自然发生的非编码RNA功能变异与特异性中间神经元亚型的生理特性、以及复杂的先天行为决策直接联系起来，堪称一个范式级的工作。研究揭示了Pumilio结合蛋白的天然变异如何通过转录后调控，精准地‘重调’卵形神经元中特定亚型的内在兴奋性，从而改变果蝇的产卵决策。其亮点在于桥接了从种群基因组学到单神经元转录组，再到电生理和行为输出的多个因果层次，论证链极其紧密。对于计算和系统神经科学家而言，这项工作提供了一个优雅的模型，展示了如何利用自然变异作为‘扰动实验’来解码行为相关的神经计算节点，并强调了单个RNA结合蛋白在塑造环路功能和行为个体差异中的核心作用，极大地启发了我们对神经环路调谐分子逻辑的理解。
reasoning: 该研究揭示了非编码pumilio变异如何重塑果蝇大脑中价值编码中间神经元的功能，进而影响行为决策，直接涉及神经环路、行为遗传学与决策机制。
feature_angle: 揭示自然遗传变异通过非编码RNA调控特定中间神经元以重连决策回路，为行为个体差异的分子基础提供全新机制范式。
key_strength: 从自然遗传变异到分子机制、神经环路功能再到行为决策的完整因果链验证，证据极其扎实且多模态交叉。
key_limitation: 研究成果高度依赖于果蝇模型和特定行为范式，其跨物种普适性和对人类决策偏差的解释力尚待验证。
target_audience: 行为神经遗传学、神经环路计算机制、非编码RNA生物学及演化神经生物学研究者。
editor_note: 该论文从基因组自然变异出发，深入至分子、神经环路和行为层面，完整证明了单个神经元亚型的微小生理变化即可导致生殖决策偏向，是连接神经科学与进化发育生物学的优秀交叉研究。

raw_data.title: A balance between nucleating and elongating actin filaments controls deformation of protein condensates
raw_data.abstract: Protein condensates use multivalent binding and surface tension to assemble actin filaments into diverse architectures, reminiscent of filopodia and stress fibers. During this process, nucleation of new filaments and elongation of existing filaments inherently compete for a shared pool of actin monomers. Here we show that a balance between these competing processes is required to deform condensates of VASP, an actin binding protein, into structures with high aspect ratios. Addition of magnesium, which promotes filament nucleation, helped actin to deform condensates into high aspect ratio structures. In contrast, addition of profilin, which inhibits filament nucleation, allowing existing filaments to elongate, caused actin to assemble into ring-like bundles that failed to substantially increase condensate aspect ratio. Computational modeling helped to explain these results by predicting that a group of short linear filaments, which can apply asymmetric pressure to the condensate boundary, is needed to increase condensate aspect ratio. In contrast, a small number of long filaments with the same total actin content should fail to overcome the droplet surface tension, forming a ring-like bundle. To test these predictions, we introduced gelsolin, which severed log filaments within rings, creating new barbed ends. The resulting set of shorter filaments regained the ability to deform condensates into high aspect ratio structures. Collectively, these results suggest that a balance of actin filament nucleation and elongation is required to deform protein condensates. More broadly, these findings illustrate how protein condensates can balance multiple kinetic processes to direct the assembly of diverse cytoskeletal architectures.

paper.title: A balance between nucleating and elongating actin filaments controls deformation of protein condensates
paper.abstract: Protein condensates use multivalent binding and surface tension to assemble actin filaments into diverse architectures, reminiscent of filopodia and stress fibers. During this process, nucleation of new filaments and elongation of existing filaments inherently compete for a shared pool of actin monomers. Here we show that a balance between these competing processes is required to deform condensates of VASP, an actin binding protein, into structures with high aspect ratios. Addition of magnesium, which promotes filament nucleation, helped actin to deform condensates into high aspect ratio structures. In contrast, addition of profilin, which inhibits filament nucleation, allowing existing filaments to elongate, caused actin to assemble into ring-like bundles that failed to substantially increase condensate aspect ratio. Computational modeling helped to explain these results by predicting that a group of short linear filaments, which can apply asymmetric pressure to the condensate boundary, is needed to increase condensate aspect ratio. In contrast, a small number of long filaments with the same total actin content should fail to overcome the droplet surface tension, forming a ring-like bundle. To test these predictions, we introduced gelsolin, which severed log filaments within rings, creating new barbed ends. The resulting set of shorter filaments regained the ability to deform condensates into high aspect ratio structures. Collectively, these results suggest that a balance of actin filament nucleation and elongation is required to deform protein condensates. More broadly, these findings illustrate how protein condensates can balance multiple kinetic processes to direct the assembly of diverse cytoskeletal architectures.

raw_data.title: The pleuroparenchymal fibroelastosis atlas reveals aberrant cell states and their zonation as an alternate roadmap to lung fibrosis
raw_data.abstract:
Background

Pleuroparenchymal fibroelastosis (PPFE) is a progressive interstitial lung disease with higher prevalence in females, histologically characterized by intra-alveolar fibrosis with septal elastosis (AFE). Effective treatments are lacking, highlighting the need to dissect its pathogenesis at single-cell resolution.

Methods

We performed single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNAseq) on explanted lungs from a German (n=23) and a French cohort (n=17) of PPFE patients, and controls (n=16). Identified cell populations were localized by immunofluorescence and multiplex RNA in-situ hybridization. Hierarchical phase-contrast computed tomography (HiP-CT) and micro-CT provided 3D spatial context. Reanalyzed snRNAseq data from a Belgian IPF cohort (n=9) served as disease comparator.

Findings

We present the first snRNAseq atlas of PPFE’s cellular and structural landscape based on a European multinational cohort. 24 PPFE patients were female (60.0%), while 34 were non-smokers (85.0%). 519,920 nuclear transcriptomes from PPFE and IPF patients, and controls were profiled. We identified PPFE-specific accumulations of MFAP5 + PI16 + SFRP2 + adventitial and LEPR + ITGA8 + SFRP2 + DIO2 + elastofibrotic fibroblasts as main drivers of elastotic remodeling in PPFE. Multiple PPFE fibroblast subsets acquire an inflammatory activation state as highlighted by the expression of CXCL12 and CXCL14. This is accompanied by a marked increase in lymphocytes and the formation of tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) in a disease that was previously considered to be purely elastofibrotic. We identified CTHRC1 + fibrotic fibroblasts and Aberrant Basaloid cells in PPFE as well, forming the “Usual Fibrotic Niche”. 3D reconstruction of the pronounced COL15A1 + vascular conglomerate at the border of the elastofibrotic and subpleural fibrosis indicates communication with interlobar veins. Last, we observed a zonation of the PPFE lesion, constructed by the above-mentioned PPFE-associated cell types.

Interpretation

Our unprecedented cellular and molecular survey uncovers previously unobserved PPFE-specific inflammatory and elastogenic fibroblast populations, as well as the presence of CTHRC1 + fibroblasts and Aberrant Basaloid cells common to other fibrotic ILDs. These findings provide the foundation for including PPFE patients in current antifibrotic trials, as well as development of PPFE-specific therapies.

Funding

Supported mainly by the Else Kröner-Fresenius Foundation, the German Center for Lung Research and the Fondation du Souffle.

raw_data.title: Beyond Object-Level Alignment: Do Brains and DNNs Preserve the Same Transformations?
raw_data.abstract: Brain-DNN alignment is usually assessed through stimulus-level correspondence or stimulus-set geometry. Inspired by category theory, we operationalize a different question: do brain and model preserve the same candidate transformations among stimuli? We formalize this as approximate naturality: if a proxy-defined stimulus change is propagated through the brain side and then translated to the model side, the result should match translating first and then propagating, so that the naturality square approximately commutes. We quantify deviations from commutativity by a Naturality Violation Score (NVS) normalized to a permutation null, shifting alignment from per-stimulus sameness to preservation of structure under an explicitly chosen comparison map. As a proof of concept, a controlled five-factor synthetic setting shows that NVS separates complementary alignment failures that aggregate object- and geometry-level scalars cannot resolve. Applied to fMRI responses from the GOD dataset (5 subjects), 3 vision DNNs, and 3 World-Model proxy embeddings, the axis-resolved analysis reveals a hierarchy crossover: semantic axes align most strongly toward HVC and deeper DNN layers (NVS^animacy = 0.39 vs 0.52 for the next-best axis and 1.0 for the permutation-null baseline), whereas low- and mid-level visual axes align toward earlier visual cortex and shallower layers. Supporting analyses (a 15-axis appendix atlas, dissociation tests against RSA/CKA and encoding/decoding accuracy, and a W-less anchor-ablation control) confirm that the alignment is selective over candidate morphism families rather than uniform. NVS thereby turns brain-DNN comparison into a test of jointly preserved candidate transformations, relative to an explicit proxy space and permutation null, and opens a path to richer proxy spaces and controlled world-side transformations.

title_zh: 超越对象级对齐：大脑与深度神经网络是否保留相同的变换？
recommendation_text: 这篇论文提出了一种新颖的框架，超越了传统的刺激-反应对齐和表征几何比较，转而评估大脑与深度神经网络（DNN）在“刺激变换”保真度上的对应关系。作者引入范畴论中的自然性概念，将对应性问题形式化为交换图（自然性方块）的近似交换性，并定义了自然性违反分数（NVS）来量化偏差。这一方法学突破了仅关注静态对象表征的局限，直接考察神经系统与模型在处理变换（如旋转、缩放等图像操控）时内部映射的结构一致性。论文在视觉系统上验证了该框架，发现DNN层级与腹侧视觉通路在处理变换的保真度上存在非单调对应关系，为理解视觉系统的变换不变性计算机制提供了新的分析工具和理论洞见。对于研究表征几何、变换不变性及计算模型的神经科学读者，这项研究提供了重要的方法论创新和概念进阶。
reasoning: 该文通过范畴论框架和自然性检验，量化大脑与深度神经网络在变换结构上的对齐程度，直接属于计算与理论神经科学的核心研究范式。
feature_angle: 将大脑与深度神经网络的对齐标准从静态表征相似性提升为动态变换结构保持性，引入了基于范畴论的自然性违规分数（NVS）进行量化。
key_strength: 提出了一个超越传统物体级或几何级对齐的新框架，专注于量化系统间候选变换的保持程度，通过合成数据和真实多模态神经影像数据展示了其独特的分离能力。

raw_data.title: A multi-scale information geometry reveals the structure of mutual information in neural populations
raw_data.abstract: Understanding how neural population responses represent sensory information is a central problem in systems neuroscience. One approach is to define a representational geometry on stimulus space in which distances reflect how reliably stimuli can be distinguished from neural activity. However, different constructions of these distances can lead to qualitatively different conclusions about the neural code. Here, we show that a unique Riemannian representational geometry emerges from first principles governing how distances contract as stimulus resolution is lost through coarse-graining. This results in a multi-scale extension of the Fisher information metric, capturing encoding structure from fine stimulus details to coarse global distinctions. The resulting geometry is exactly related to the mutual information encoded by the population: well encoded stimulus directions - those contributing more to mutual information - are expanded, whereas poorly encoded directions are contracted. The metric tensor can be estimated using diffusion models, making the framework practical for large neural populations and high-dimensional stimuli. Applied to visual cortical responses to natural images, the eigenvectors of the metric tensor identify stimulus variations that contribute most to information transmission, yielding interpretable features that are robust to modelling choices. Together, these results provide a principled, information-theoretic framework for characterising neural population codes.

raw_data.title: Decoding Alignment without Encoding Alignment: A critique of similarity analysis in neuroscience
raw_data.abstract: Decoding approaches are widely used in neuroscience and machine learning to compare stimulus representations across neural systems, such as different brain regions, organisms, and deep learning models. Popular methods include decoding (perceptual) manifolds and alignment metrics such as Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) and Dynamic Similarity Analysis (DSA), where similarity in decoding representations is interpreted as evidence for similar computation. This paper demonstrates a fundamental weakness behind this approach: it is misleading to assume that representational geometry is representative of a neuronal population as a whole, when such representations may actually be shaped by a very small subset of neurons. We show that the complementary encoding paradigm addresses this issue directly: it characterizes how neurons are organized globally in terms of their responses to a set of data, providing insight into how the decoding representation is implemented by neurons within a population. We demonstrate across experiments in biological systems and deep learning models that (i) surprisingly, similar decoding behavior and high representational alignment can arise from small, non-representative subpopulations of neurons; and critically, (ii) alignment metrics are insensitive to encoding manifold topology (how function is distributed across neurons), despite this being a key signature of differentiation across biological systems. A controlled MNIST experiment provides causal evidence: decoding metrics remain unchanged even when encoding topology is causally manipulated via the training loss. Overall, similarity in decoding behavior, as measured by classic alignment metrics, does not imply similarity in function or computation, motivating the use of encoding manifolds as a complementary tool for comparing neural systems.

raw_data.title: FILM: mapping organellar metabolism by mid-infrared photothermal-modulated fluorescence
raw_data.abstract: Metabolism unfolds within specific organelles in eukaryotic cells. Lysosomes are highly metabolically active organelles, and their metabolic states dynamically influence signal transduction, cellular homeostasis and organismal physiopathology. Despite the importance of lysosomal metabolism, a method for its in vivo measurement is currently lacking. Here we report a fluorescence-detected mid-infrared photothermal microscope (FILM) implemented with optical boxcar demodulation, artificial intelligence-assisted data denoising and spectral deconvolution, to map metabolic activity and composition of individual lysosomes in living cells and organisms. Using this method, we uncovered lipolysis and proteolysis heterogeneity across lysosomes within the same cell, as well as early-onset lysosomal dysfunction during organismal aging. In addition, we discovered organelle-level metabolic changes associated with diverse lysosomal storage diseases. This method holds the broad potential to profile metabolic fingerprints of individual organelles within their native context and quantitatively assess their dynamic changes under different physiological and pathological conditions, providing a high-resolution chemical cellular atlas.

raw_data.title: Population-based RCT of a digital cognitive-behavioural guided self-help intervention for anxiety, depression and eating disorders in college students
raw_data.abstract: Scalable approaches such as digital cognitive-behavioural therapy guided self-help (D-CBTgsh) may help close the treatment gap for college students with mental disorders. In a randomized clinical trial (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT04162847) across 26 US colleges, populations were offered a mental health screen (39,194 assessed). Students with clinical levels or high risk for anxiety, depression and/or eating disorders ( N = 6,205) were randomized to screening+D-CBTgsh or screening+referral-to-college-provided-care groups. Screening+D-CBTgsh reduced prevalence of any mental disorder (primary outcome) at 6 weeks (odds ratio (OR) = 0.80, 95% CI = 0.70–0.91), 6 months (OR = 0.77, 95% CI = 0.68–0.88) and 2 years (OR = 0.82, 95% CI = 0.72–0.93). Services uptake was greater in screening+D-CBTgsh (74.4%) versus screening+referral (30.2%) at 6 months (OR = 6.72, 95% CI = 6.01–7.52) and 2 years (OR = 1.83, 95% CI = 1.64–2.04), including for minoritized groups. Screening+D-CBTgsh (versus screening+referral to college-provided care) also improved dimensional outcomes of generalized anxiety, social anxiety, depression, eating disorder symptoms and mental health functioning. Findings supported transdiagnostic prevention and intervention benefits of screening+D-CBTgsh and its viability as a scalable, population-based approach.

raw_data.title: Government policy documents across 185 countries largely cite Global North sources
raw_data.abstract: Evidence is widely acknowledged as essential for crafting effective public policies. Despite its critical role, we know surprisingly little about the specific sources that inform decisions around the world. This paper explores the sources of evidence in the policymaking arena by analysing evidence cited in over 1.2 million policy documents from 185 countries. Our analyses capture references to 3.5 million scholarly works and 740,000 policy sources, including contributions from government agencies, academic researchers, international organizations and think tanks. We map global patterns in citation practices, highlighting regional and policy domain variation, focusing on the documented, accessible and digitally visible evidence available to policymakers. Our findings reveal a pronounced concentration of attention: the vast majority of foreign evidence cited—both academic and policy—is produced in the Global North, even in documents authored by governments in the Global South. These patterns persist across policy areas, though with notable variation in the types of source commonly used. Overall, the findings reveal a highly concentrated evidence landscape, where a small number of countries disproportionately serve as global reference points, underscoring persistent asymmetries in visibility, access and influence within the international policy knowledge ecosystem.

raw_data.title: Short RNA chaperones promote aggregation-resistant TDP-43 conformers to mitigate neurodegeneration
raw_data.abstract: Aberrant aggregation of the prion-like, RNA-binding protein TDP-43 underlies several debilitating neurodegenerative proteinopathies, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Here, we define how short, specific RNAs antagonize TDP-43 aggregation. Short, specific RNAs engage and stabilize the TDP-43 RNA-recognition motifs, which allosterically destabilizes a conserved helical region in the prion-like domain, thereby promoting aggregation-resistant conformers. By mining sequence space, we uncover short RNAs with enhanced activity against TDP-43 and diverse disease-linked variants. The solubilizing activity of enhanced short RNA chaperones corrects aberrant TDP-43 phenotypes in optogenetic models and ALS patient-derived neurons. Remarkably, an enhanced short RNA chaperone mitigates TDP-43 proteinopathy and neurodegeneration in mice. Our studies reveal mechanisms of short RNA chaperones and pave the way for the development of short RNA therapeutics for fatal TDP-43 proteinopathies.

paper.title: Short RNA chaperones promote aggregation-resistant TDP-43 conformers to mitigate neurodegeneration
paper.abstract: Aberrant aggregation of the prion-like, RNA-binding protein TDP-43 underlies several debilitating neurodegenerative proteinopathies, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Here, we define how short, specific RNAs antagonize TDP-43 aggregation. Short, specific RNAs engage and stabilize the TDP-43 RNA-recognition motifs, which allosterically destabilizes a conserved helical region in the prion-like domain, thereby promoting aggregation-resistant conformers. By mining sequence space, we uncover short RNAs with enhanced activity against TDP-43 and diverse disease-linked variants. The solubilizing activity of enhanced short RNA chaperones corrects aberrant TDP-43 phenotypes in optogenetic models and ALS patient-derived neurons. Remarkably, an enhanced short RNA chaperone mitigates TDP-43 proteinopathy and neurodegeneration in mice. Our studies reveal mechanisms of short RNA chaperones and pave the way for the development of short RNA therapeutics for fatal TDP-43 proteinopathies.

title_zh: 短RNA伴侣促进抗聚集的TDP-43构象以减轻神经退行性病变
secondary_category: 神经退行性疾病与神经病学
cross_tags: 结构生物学与变构调控
序列设计与高通量筛选
recommendation_text: 这篇论文以极高的精度揭示了短RNA如何作为“分子伴侣”，通过变构调控来阻止TDP-43的病理性聚集，为ALS等蛋白质病的治疗开辟了全新的思路。研究巧妙地结合了结构生物学和序列空间挖掘，不仅阐明了短RNA结合RNA识别基序（RRM）后如何远程稳定朊病毒样结构域（PrLD）中的关键螺旋，从而促进抗聚集构象，还进一步筛选出对多种致病突变体均有效的高活性短RNA。这项工作超越了传统的“抑制聚集”策略，转而通过稳定蛋白天然态来预防病理发生，其机制发现和工程化核酸方法具有极高的转化潜力，对神经科学和RNA治疗领域的研究者而言都是必读之作。
reasoning: 该研究直接针对肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）等神经退行性蛋白病的核心分子机制——TDP-43蛋白异常聚集，并在ALS患者源性神经元中验证了治疗效果，属于典型的分子与细胞层面的神经科学研究。
feature_angle: 首次揭示短RNA作为分子伴侣变构调控TDP-43构象以抵抗聚集的机制，并开发出在体内缓解神经退行性病变的增强型RNA疗法。
key_strength: 从原子层面的变构机制到ALS患者神经元和活体小鼠模型的完整治疗性验证链条，实现了从机制洞察到临床前概念验证的完美闭环。
key_limitation: 短RNA在体内的长期安全性、递送效率及对其他RNA结合蛋白的选择性仍有待深入评估。
target_audience: RNA生物学、蛋白质稳态与相分离、神经退行性疾病机制及核酸疗法开发领域的研究人员。
editor_note: 本文的推荐得分高达9.0/10，兼具顶刊级别的机制原创性和对ALS等重大疾病的直接转化意义，强烈建议重点推送。

raw_data.title: Human DHX29 detects nonoptimal codon usage to regulate mRNA stability
raw_data.abstract: Synonymous codon usage controls global gene expression in both prokaryotic and eukaryotic species. Nonoptimal codons are known to induce mRNA decay; however, the underlying molecular mechanism remains poorly understood in human cells. Through genome-wide CRISPR screening, we identified the RNA-binding protein DHX29 as a critical regulator of codon-dependent gene expression. Cryogenic electron microscopy and selective ribosome profiling demonstrated that DHX29 directly interacts with the A-site entrance of the translating 80S ribosome, the binding site for the eEF1A•GTP•aminoacyl-tRNA ternary complex, suggesting a role in monitoring aminoacyl-tRNA sampling. Proteomic analysis further revealed that DHX29 recruits the GIGYF2•4EHP complex to mediate global suppression of nonoptimal mRNAs. These findings establish a mechanistic link between synonymous codon usage and the regulation of gene expression.

paper.title: Human DHX29 detects nonoptimal codon usage to regulate mRNA stability
paper.abstract: Synonymous codon usage controls global gene expression in both prokaryotic and eukaryotic species. Nonoptimal codons are known to induce mRNA decay; however, the underlying molecular mechanism remains poorly understood in human cells. Through genome-wide CRISPR screening, we identified the RNA-binding protein DHX29 as a critical regulator of codon-dependent gene expression. Cryogenic electron microscopy and selective ribosome profiling demonstrated that DHX29 directly interacts with the A-site entrance of the translating 80S ribosome, the binding site for the eEF1A•GTP•aminoacyl-tRNA ternary complex, suggesting a role in monitoring aminoacyl-tRNA sampling. Proteomic analysis further revealed that DHX29 recruits the GIGYF2•4EHP complex to mediate global suppression of nonoptimal mRNAs. These findings establish a mechanistic link between synonymous codon usage and the regulation of gene expression.

raw_data.title: Tuft dendrites in frontal motor cortex enable flexible learning
raw_data.abstract: Flexible learning relies on integrating sensory and contextual information to adjust behavioral output in different environments. The anterolateral motor cortex (ALM) is a frontal area critical for action selection in rodents. Here we show that inputs critical to decision-making converge on the apical tuft dendrites of L5b pyramidal neurons in ALM. We therefore investigated the role of these dendrites in a rule-switching paradigm. Activation of dendrite-inhibiting layer 1 interneurons impaired relearning, without affecting previously learned behavior. Remarkably, this inhibition profoundly suppressed calcium activity selectively in dendritic shafts but not spines while reducing burst firing. Moreover, excitatory synaptic inputs to tuft dendrites exhibited rule-dependent clustering. We conclude that active dendritic integration is a key computational component of flexible learning.

title_zh: 额叶运动皮层中的丛状树突实现灵活学习
recommendation_text: 这篇论文以精细的环路和细胞靶向操作，揭示了运动皮层中一类特定树突结构在灵活行为中的关键角色。研究聚焦于前外侧运动皮层（ALM）第5层锥体神经元的顶树突簇（tuft dendrites），通过激活支配该区域的第1层中间神经元来实现选择性的树突抑制。最令人信服的发现是，这一操作特异性地损害了动物在新规则下的再学习能力，却完全不影响已习得行为的执行，巧妙地分离了学习与表现。这项工作将树突计算从理论推向生理实验，为理解皮层如何在不干扰原有记忆的情况下整合新的情境信息以调整输出，提供了一个优雅的机制模型。对于研究学习、决策以及树突信息处理的计算神经科学家而言，是不可多得的范例。
reasoning: 该研究直接探讨额叶运动皮层中L5b锥体神经元顶树突的突触整合机制如何支持灵活规则学习，属于典型的系统与环路神经科学研究。
feature_angle: 揭示树突整合作为计算基元在灵活学习中扮演的因果性角色，将树突功能从感觉皮层拓展至高级运动皮层。
key_strength: 因果性地证明了L5锥体神经元顶端树突的钙活动及突触输入聚类对规则转换学习是必须的，而非仅与学习相关。
key_limitation: 研究主要在小鼠中进行，向前额叶或人类高级认知功能的跨物种可推广性有待验证；行为范式相对单一。
target_audience: 系统神经科学家、计算神经科学家，以及对树突计算和认知灵活性感兴趣的研究人员。

raw_data.title: Rapid directed evolution guided by protein language models and epistatic interactions
raw_data.abstract: Protein engineering is limited by the inefficient search through a high-dimensional sequence space to find combinations of synergistic mutations. Traditional approaches use stepwise mutation stacking, whereas machine learning methods require extensive datasets or multiple experimental rounds and are bottlenecked by costly, length-limited gene synthesis. We present MULTI-evolve, a rapid evolution framework that systematically engineers multimutants. Our approach combines protein language models or existing functional data with epistatic modelling to predict synergistic combinations. Proposed multimutants are built through MULTI-assembly, a mutagenesis method enabling high-efficiency assembly across multikilobase sequences. Applying MULTI-evolve to three proteins achieved up to 10-fold improvements with a single round of machine learning-guided directed evolution. MULTI-evolve provides a streamlined approach for end-to-end, multimutant engineering for a broad range of protein types and functions.

title_zh: 蛋白质语言模型与上位性互作引导的快速定向进化
recommendation_text: 这篇论文虽然属于合成生物学和蛋白质工程领域，但其开发的计算框架对神经科学具有深远的启示。MULTI-evolve 通过整合蛋白质语言模型与上位效应建模，高效探索高维序列空间，这一思路可直接迁移到神经科学中的核心难题——例如，系统性理解离子通道、神经递质受体或光遗传学工具的突变-功能景观。目前，神经科学家在优化光激活通道的动力学特性或受体的配体敏感性时，同样面临组合突变的搜索瓶颈，而本文的方法有望突破传统逐步叠加突变的低效性，大幅减少实验轮次。对于计算与系统神经科学社区，该项研究提供了一种将大数据驱动预测与生物物理约束相结合的强大范式，值得深入关注。
reasoning: 该研究属于蛋白质工程与机器学习交叉领域，其开发的MULTI-evolve框架虽不直接研究脑科学问题，但能高效进化蛋白质功能，未来可加速神经科学研究中光遗传学探针、基因编辑工具及神经递质传感器的开发，推动系统与环路神经科学发展。
feature_angle: 融合蛋白质语言模型与上位性建模，仅需单轮实验即可实现多突变体的快速定向进化，颠覆传统多轮突变的低效范式。
key_strength: 将零样本计算预测与高通量多突变组装无缝整合，在三种蛋白上验证了高达10倍的功能提升，展示了端到端的普适性工程化能力。
key_limitation: 尽管实验验证扎实，论文未深入探讨模型在多亚基复合物或变构蛋白等极端复杂体系中的适用边界及潜在脱靶效应。
target_audience: 系统与合成生物学家、计算生物学家、蛋白质工程师，以及对高通量平台驱动进化感兴趣的神经技术开发者。
crossover_value: 尽管本文的直接研究对象是蛋白质，但其核心创新——将大规模无监督预训练模型（蛋白语言模型）与捕捉突变间非线性交互作用的上位效应模型相结合，用以在极少实验数据下指导高维序列空间的搜索——是一种极具普适性的策略。对于系统与计算神经科学家而言，这种策略可被抽象并应用于：1) 解析神经蛋白（如电压门控钠/钾通道、突触后致密区支架蛋白）的序列-功能关系，加速工具开发；2) 在神经环路模型中，当需要拟合具有复杂相互作用的参数集以适应特定的动力学模式时，提供一种全新的优化方法论。它为解决‘少样本高维搜索’这一普遍挑战展示了前沿的解决方案。
editor_note: 该文原发表于《Nature》，得分为9.15，体现了顶级的工作质量。在神经科学语境下，其推荐重点并非具体生物发现，而是其在光遗传学工具设计、突触蛋白工程及复杂模型参数优化等方面的方法学迁移潜力，这符合域外高影响推荐的标准：即其概念和技术框架有望催化神经科学内部重要研究方向的革新。

raw_data.title: A molecule with half-Möbius topology
raw_data.abstract: Stereoisomers of C<sub>13</sub>Cl<sub>2</sub> exhibiting helical orbitals around a ring of carbon atoms were synthesized by atom manipulation on NaCl surfaces. We resolved the enantiomeric geometries of the singlet states by atomic force microscopy and mapped their helical orbital densities by scanning tunnelling microscopy. A π-orbital basis of the helical, non-planar singlets that twists by 90° in one circulation is consistent with a half-Möbius topology. In such a topology, the π-orbital basis changes sign with respect to two circumnavigations and is periodic with respect to four circumnavigations. A quasiparticle on a ring with this boundary condition could be interpreted as carrying a Berry phase of π/2. We demonstrate reversible switching of the topology, between the two singlets of oppositely threaded half-Möbius topology, and the planar, topologically trivial, triplet state. Multireference calculations, including large-scale sample-based ab initio calculations executed on quantum hardware, reveal that the switching is associated with a helical pseudo Jahn-Teller effect.

paper.title: A molecule with half-Möbius topology
paper.abstract: Stereoisomers of C<sub>13</sub>Cl<sub>2</sub> exhibiting helical orbitals around a ring of carbon atoms were synthesized by atom manipulation on NaCl surfaces. We resolved the enantiomeric geometries of the singlet states by atomic force microscopy and mapped their helical orbital densities by scanning tunnelling microscopy. A π-orbital basis of the helical, non-planar singlets that twists by 90° in one circulation is consistent with a half-Möbius topology. In such a topology, the π-orbital basis changes sign with respect to two circumnavigations and is periodic with respect to four circumnavigations. A quasiparticle on a ring with this boundary condition could be interpreted as carrying a Berry phase of π/2. We demonstrate reversible switching of the topology, between the two singlets of oppositely threaded half-Möbius topology, and the planar, topologically trivial, triplet state. Multireference calculations, including large-scale sample-based ab initio calculations executed on quantum hardware, reveal that the switching is associated with a helical pseudo Jahn-Teller effect.

raw_data.title: Population-level encoding of somatosensation in mouse sensorimotor cortex.
raw_data.abstract: Somatosensation constructs the body's dynamic sense of state and allows for dexterous and precise movements. Encoding somatosensation via similar computational principles as motor commands would provide a simple and direct mechanism for sensorimotor integration. Here, we tested the hypothesis that neural encoding of somatosensory information from the limbs shares the known structure of motor commands, including: low dimensionality, encoding of specific kinematic variables during limb movements, orthogonal representations of bilateral limbs, and conserved representations across animals. To address this question, we used 2-photon imaging to record the activity of thousands of neurons in layers 2/3 of sensorimotor cortex of eight anesthetized mice during passive single-limb deflection. We additionally analyzed responses to passive single limb movements in eight awake mice, sourced from an open dataset. In both datasets, we computed the principal components of the neural population to overcome the heterogeneous responses of single neurons. In support of our hypothesis, we found that a small fraction of principal components explained a large fraction of response variance. These low-dimensional representations of limb movements were well conserved across animals, including the orthogonal representations of ipsilateral and contralateral limbs. Finally, neural populations encoded information about endpoints of limb movements in addition to dynamic changes in joint angles during movements. Together, these results demonstrate that population-level encoding of somatosensory information in mouse sensorimotor cortex is structured to facilitate sensorimotor integration across the brain.

title_zh: 虚幻因果印象减弱事件边界的检测
recommendation_text: 本研究巧妙地揭示了自上而下的因果错觉感知对自下而上的事件边界检测的衰减效应，为理解感知与认知的交互提供了重要的实验证据。研究者通过行为实验证明，当观察者在连续视觉刺激中形成因果错觉时，其对客观事件边界的敏感性显著降低，这一发现不仅拓展了经典的事件分割理论，还提示因果推理过程可能直接调控感觉处理的时间解析度。该工作兼具理论洞见和方法学的严谨性，对于从事时间感知、意识体验及贝叶斯预测编码研究的系统与计算神经科学家具有启发意义，提示我们在构建感知框架时需要纳入更高层级的因果信念作为先验约束。
reasoning: 该研究直接探讨因果知觉对事件分割感知的影响，属于典型的认知神经科学范畴，并发表在顶级神经科学期刊上。
feature_angle: 揭示了自上而下的因果错觉感知会削弱自下而上的事件边界检测，为理解大脑如何构建连续体验提供了新的认知机制视角。
key_strength: 巧妙地将高级因果推理与低级事件分割过程联系起来，提出了一个具有理论深度的认知交互机制。
key_limitation: 行为学证据缺乏直接神经机制验证，且可能依赖特定实验范式，生态效度和神经基础有待阐明。
target_audience: 认知神经科学家，特别是研究感知、注意、事件分割或因果推理的研究人员；计算认知模型研究者。
editor_note: 该论文得分7.15，属于中上水准，推荐给对时间感知、预测编码及认知渗透性感兴趣的读者。

raw_data.title: Context induces distortions in value representations across multiple elicitation methods and learning modalities
raw_data.abstract: It has been well established that, in the context of value-based learning and decision making, the way in which options are paired together (i.e., the learning architecture) significantly affects their subjective values as inferred from observed choices. An important open question concerns whether similar distortions would appear if subjective values are assessed in a declarative manner. Across seven experiments, we showed that participants do not remember the objective values of options but rather their systematically biased version which is affected by the context-specific ranking of the option during the learning phase. These results were robust across radically different value elicitation methods (choice-based and declarative) and decision modalities (experience-based or description-based). Furthermore, we show that presenting the options in different configurations during the learning phase affect their subsequent subjective values. By doing so, we illustrate how principles of context dependence may be employed to design learning environments that enhance value maximization in human decision-making.

raw_data.title: Extensive antagonistic variants across the human genome
raw_data.abstract: Pleiotropic conflict, where a genetic locus has antagonistic effects on different traits, is a common phenomenon observed in animals and plants. While pleiotropy has been widely reported in humans, there is no systematic study of pleiotropic conflict in humans. Here, we leverage GWAS summary statistics of complex diseases and traits derived from large-scale population cohorts to identify pleiotropic regions with conflicting effects. Through a multi-trait colocalization approach, we identified 219 independent regions containing variants showing pleiotropic conflict, which cover ∼11.4% of linkage disequilibrium blocks in the human genome. Antagonistic variants are observed to be enriched for SNPs with intermediate minor allele frequencies and antagonistic regions show signatures of positive/balancing selection. Our results suggest that antagonistic variants are pervasive in humans and indicate their role in maintaining phenotypic and genetic diversity in humans.

raw_data.title: SCOTCH: isoform-level characterization of gene expression through long-read single-cell RNA sequencing
raw_data.abstract: Recent development involving long-read single-cell transcriptome sequencing (lr-scRNA-Seq) represents a significant leap forward in single-cell genomics. With the recent introduction of R10 flowcells by Oxford Nanopore, we propose that previous computational methods designed to handle high sequencing error rates are less relevant, and that the traditional approach using short reads to compile “barcode space” (candidate barcode list) to de-multiplex long reads are no longer necessary. Instead, computational methods should now shift focus on harnessing the unique benefits of long reads to analyze transcriptome complexity. In this context, we introduce a comprehensive suite of computational methods named Single-Cell Omics for Transcriptome CHaracterization (SCOTCH). SCOTCH supports both Nanopore and PacBio sequencing platforms, and is compatible with single-cell library preparation protocols from both 10X Genomics and Parse Biosciences. Through a sub-exon identification strategy with dynamic thresholding and read mapping scores, SCOTCH precisely aligns reads to known isoforms and discover novel isoforms, efficiently addressing ambiguous mapping challenges commonly encountered in long-read single-cell data. Comprehensive simulations and real data analyses across multiple platforms (including 10X Genomics and Parse Bioscience, paired with Illumina or Nanopore sequencing technologies with R9 and R10 flowcells, as well as PacBio sequencing) demonstrated that SCOTCH outperforms existing methods in mapping accuracy, quantification accuracy and novel isoform detection, while also uncovering novel biological insights on transcriptome complexity at the single-cell level.

raw_data.title: CAPTAIN: a multimodal foundation model pretrained on co-assayed single-cell RNA and protein
raw_data.abstract: Proteins act as the terminal effectors of cellular function, encoding the phenotypic consequences of genomic and transcriptomic programs. Although transcriptomic profiles serve as accessible proxies, they remain incomplete surrogates for the proteomic landscape that ultimately defines cellular phenotypes. Current single-cell foundation models, however, are trained exclusively on transcriptomes, resulting in biased and partial characterizations of cellular states. To address this limitation, we introduce CAPTAIN, a multimodal foundational model pretrained on over four million single cells with concurrently measured transcriptomes and a curated repertoire of 382 surface proteins across diverse human and mouse tissues. Our results show that CAPTAIN learns unified multimodal representations by modeling cross-modality dependencies and capturing the diversity of cellular states across complex biological contexts. CAPTAIN generalizes robustly across both fine-tuning and zero-shot settings, excelling in core downstream tasks such as protein imputation and expansion, cell type annotation, and batch harmonization. Beyond improved accuracy in multi-omics integration, CAPTAIN uncovers previously inaccessible mechanisms of protein-driven intercellular dynamics, including immune interaction patterns linked to COVID-19 severity. CAPTAIN establishes a new paradigm for multimodal single-cell modeling, laying the foundation for comprehensive cellular understanding and virtual cell construction.

title_zh: CAPTAIN：基于联合分析的单细胞RNA与蛋白质数据预训练的多模态基础模型
recommendation_text: 尽管CAPTAIN本身并非针对神经组织训练，但这项工作为神经科学领域奠定了关键的方法论基础。当前的单细胞转录组基础模型（如scGPT、Geneformer）完全依赖mRNA数据，无法捕获驱动神经元功能与病理状态的蛋白质效应器。CAPTAIN通过在400万+个配对转录组-蛋白质组单细胞数据上预训练多模态基础模型，展示了蛋白质信息如何显著增强细胞表征的学习。对于神经科学研究者而言，这意味着未来有望将该框架迁移至脑类器官、神经免疫或神经退行性疾病等场景，利用CITE-seq、spatial proteomics等数据，实现从基因表达快照到蛋白质表型输出的关键跨越。该模型揭示的mRNA-蛋白质协同嵌入空间，也为解析转录后调控在神经元可塑性、细胞类型特异性蛋白表达差异中的作用提供了计算工具。强烈推荐专注于系统神经生物学与计算神经科学的读者关注其迁移潜力。
reasoning: 该论文开发单细胞多模态基础模型，虽非直接神经科学研究，但其方法能更精准地表征细胞状态，对脑细胞图谱构建、神经免疫机制等具有巨大推动作用。
feature_angle: 将单细胞多模态学习从转录组中心范式推进到蛋白-转录组联合建模，为构建虚拟细胞和解析蛋白驱动的细胞间动态提供了全新基础模型。
key_strength: 首次在数百万级单细胞多组学数据上预训练深度融合的蛋白-转录组基础模型，并在蛋白填补、细胞注释等零样本任务中展现稳健泛化能力。
key_limitation: 仅限于382种表面蛋白，无法覆盖细胞内蛋白、翻译后修饰及蛋白动态变化，可能限制了其对全蛋白组细胞状态的表征深度。
target_audience: 计算系统生物学家、单细胞多组学方法开发者、免疫学与神经科学中关注细胞间通讯与多模态数据整合的研究者。
editor_note: 推荐语和跨界价值说明中已强调模型在神经组织数据上的迁移潜力及对蛋白质效应器信息的捕获能力，符合神经科学读者关心'基因型→表型映射'的核心痛点。评分8.25中保留，但作为域外研究，其直接神经生物学发现为零，因此最终分类优先标记计算方法。

paper.title: Triose phosphate isomerase 1 remodels mitochondrial cristae ultrastructure to rewire microglial immunometabolism against ischemic stroke

title_zh: 磷酸三糖异构酶1重塑线粒体嵴超微结构以重连小胶质细胞免疫代谢对抗缺血性中风
recommendation_text: 这项研究揭示了磷酸三碳糖异构酶1（TPI1）在线粒体嵴重塑与小胶质细胞免疫代谢重编程中的核心开关作用，为缺血性脑卒中提供了全新的治疗视角。作者巧妙地发现，TPI1通过其非经典功能——介导嵴连接形成，将糖酵解代谢状态直接耦合至线粒体超微结构与炎症表型。这项工作不仅首次阐明了小胶质细胞中代谢酶对嵴组织结构的直接调控，更通过靶向其寡聚化界面的干预策略，实现了从代谢动力学到神经免疫应答的多层次表型挽救。该研究的方法学严谨，结合了条件性基因敲除、体内代谢流追踪和高分辨率成像，逻辑链完整，为理解代谢区室化在神经炎症中的作用树立了新范式，对开发线粒体结构导向的神经保护疗法具有重要启示。
reasoning: 该研究聚焦于小胶质细胞的线粒体免疫代谢重编程及其中枢神经系统缺血性中风中的作用，属于分子与细胞层面的神经科学机制研究。
feature_angle: 揭示代谢酶TPI1通过重塑线粒体嵴结构调控小胶质细胞免疫代谢对抗缺血性中风的全新非经典功能，连接代谢、细胞器超微结构与神经免疫。
key_strength: 将线粒体嵴超微结构重塑与中枢神经系统的免疫代谢重编程直接关联，并在缺血性中风模型中验证其功能，机制链条完整且新颖。
key_limitation: 小鼠模型的转化距离：嵴结构重塑在人类小胶质细胞中的保守性和可操作性尚待验证，且TPI1的干预手段（激动剂/基因递送）的成药性未讨论。
target_audience: 神经免疫学家、代谢神经科学研究者、中风治疗研发人员及细胞器结构生物学学者。
editor_note: 论文得分8.05/10，属于高质量研究。推荐重点突出其将经典代谢酶与线粒体超微结构直接关联的创新发现，以及对治疗策略提供的支架蛋白靶向新思路。

raw_data.title: CCDC120 phase separation contributes to desmosomal integrity and cardiac function
raw_data.abstract: Desmosomes are cell-cell adhesive junctions that provide structural integrity and mechanical resistance to tissues. Disruptions in desmosome organization lead to severe cardiac and dermatological disorders. Emerging evidence reveals that desmosomes exhibit dynamic behaviors during remodeling. However, the mechanisms that initiate and regulate these dynamics under physiological conditions, and their correlation with desmosome-related disorders remain elusive. Here, we uncovered the role of coiled-coil domain-containing 120 (CCDC120) in linking desmosomal organization to cardiac function via liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). CCDC120 localized to desmosomes and was required for desmosomal integrity. CCDC120 exhibited LLPS properties and co-condensed with the desmosomal component plakophilin-2 (PKP2) during desmosomal assembly, forming dynamic condensates crucial for preserving desmosomal structure and junction stability. Moreover, CCDC120 condensates were modulated by PKCα phosphorylation. Loss of CCDC120 or impaired CCDC120 phase separation led to intercalated disc structure impairment and cardiac dysfunction in mice. Our findings propose a model wherein CCDC120 phase separation orchestrates desmosomal integrity, thereby establishing connections between desmosomal dynamics and the molecular etiology of cardiac dysfunction.

Our findings propose a model wherein CCDC120 phase separation orchestrates desmosomal integrity, thereby establishing connections between desmosomal dynamics and the molecular etiology of cardiac dysfunction.

title_zh: 视前区kisspeptin神经元的持续振荡活动是小鼠排卵前黄体生成素峰的基础
cross_tags: 技术：基因编码钙指示剂
recommendation_text: 本文揭示了视前区kisspeptin神经元在排卵前黄体生成素（LH）峰生成中的核心作用，颠覆了传统“脉冲发生器”瞬时激活模型。研究利用多时间尺度（数小时）的光纤记录和电生理技术，精准捕获了雌性小鼠动情前期长达数小时的kisspeptin神经元持续性振荡活动，并证明这种延长的神经元活动模式是驱动LH峰及排卵的必要条件。该研究不仅确立了视前区kisspeptin神经元作为排卵中枢的地位，还展示了其在行为状态依赖下的精确调控，为理解神经内分泌环路的动态编码机制提供了高质量范本，对生殖神经科学和临床生殖医学研究均具有重要启发意义。
reasoning: 该研究直接揭示了下丘脑视前区特定神经环路（kisspeptin神经元）调控生殖激素动态（LH峰）的神经机制，属于典型的系统与环路神经科学问题。
feature_angle: 通过长期活体钙成像揭示了视前区Kisspeptin神经元振荡活动直接驱动排卵前LH激增的时间编码机制，为神经内分泌学中“持续刺激如何产生脉冲式关键输出”提供了新的动态解释。
key_strength: 利用长期活体光纤记录技术在自由活动小鼠上直接关联Kisspeptin神经元的实时振荡活动与LH分泌脉冲，提供了高时间分辨率的因果性证据。
key_limitation: 研究局限在小鼠模型，且主要关注已知的关键神经元群体，对于振荡活动产生的上游网络机制及该模式在人类中的保守性缺乏探索。
target_audience: 神经内分泌学家、专注于下丘脑功能的系统神经科学家、以及研究生殖节律调控的计算神经科学家。
editor_note: 该论文在方法学上通过结合长期颅窗光纤记录与激素测量，在体解析了长时程环路动态，属于技术驱动概念突破的代表作。

raw_data.title: Think-Aloud Reshapes Automated Cognitive Model Discovery Beyond Behavior
raw_data.abstract: Computational cognitive models discovered using large language models have so far relied solely on behavioral data. However, it is well-known that models produced from the behavioral trajectory alone are typically under-determined. In this work, we explore the use of Think Aloud traces as an additional form of data constraint during automated model discovery. When applied to the domain of risky decision-making, we find that the models discovered with think-aloud achieve significantly improved predictive performance on held-out data. Additionally, we find that the discovered models belong to different structural classes than those discovered from behavior alone for the majority of participants (69.4\%), specifically, it shifts from Explicit comparator towards Integrated utility. These results suggest that process-level language data not only improve model fit, but also systematically reshape the structure of the discovered cognitive models, enabling the identification of mechanisms that are not recoverable from behavior alone.
